contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. AD340-341, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows Two soldiers, and one standard. Mint is Trier. See RIC VIII, p.145, no.105ff. Obverse shows Diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: M//[...].
